## Core Specializations & Services
1. **Enterprise AI Automation Systems**: Architecting end-to-end autonomous operational pipelines that eliminate repetitive friction and manual bottlenecks.
2. **Sub-180ms Voice Agents**: Real-time conversational AI voice agents for inbound support triage, dynamic scheduling, instant CRM updates, and client qualification.
3. **High-Performance Web Platforms**: Cinematic 60fps WebGL, 3D interactive experiences, and responsive digital storefronts tailored for conversion.
